walk-raaz:
I built the Raaz healthcare platform end to end: a React Native app, an Express/TypeScript backend, and a Supabase database, now past 55,000 patients. I wired Razorpay, Shopify, and Prozo into one order pipeline with idempotent webhook handlers and a forward-only payment state machine, so retries can't corrupt state. On top of that I built voice outreach across three telephony generations, from AI bot calls to a SmartFlo dialer to today's Plivo browser softphone, handling 200,000+ calls a month, and a clinical engine that keeps the math in code and cut consultation prep from 30 minutes to 10-15. The hard part was making every integration recover cleanly from partial failure.
Here's the full picture.

ai-work:
Most of my AI work is the clinical engine at Raaz. The scoring is all in code, eight weighted root-cause scores on validated instruments (IIEF-5, PEDT), after an early version let the LLM do the arithmetic and it got the totals wrong; Claude and Groq only format the report and patient copy. It cut consultation prep from 30 minutes to 10-15.
